analysis.topic: 《水浒传》的文学地位与深远影响
analysis.reference: Water Margin is one of the four classic novels of Chinese literature. Based on theerta of the historical figure Song Jiang and his companions whoerta against the feudal emperor, this novel has beenerta popular among Chinese readers for hundreds of years. sentences.cn: 《水浒传》(Water Margin)是中国文学四大经典小说之一。
sentences.en: Water Margin is one of the four classic novels of Chinese literature.
sentences.structure: 主系表结构，使用 one of + 最高级/限定词 + 复数名词 表示"……之一"
keys: 四大经典小说 the four classic novels
中国文学 Chinese literature

sentences.cn: 这部小说基于历史人物宋江及其伙伴反抗封建帝王的故事，数百年来一直深受中国读者的喜爱。
sentences.en: Based on the story of the historical figure Song Jiang and his companions who revolted against the feudal emperor, this novel has been immensely popular among Chinese readers for hundreds of years.
sentences.structure: 过去分词短语 Based on... 作状语置于句首，主句用现在完成时 has been，内含 who 引导的定语从句修饰 companions

反抗封建帝王 revolt against the feudal emperor

sentences.en: It is no exaggeration to say that almost every Chinese is familiar with some of the major characters in the novel.
sentences.structure: It is no exaggeration to say that... 固定句型引导主语从句，that 从句内部为 be familiar with 结构

sentences.cn: 这部小说中的精彩故事在茶馆、戏剧舞台、广播电视、电影屏幕和无数家庭中反复讲述。
sentences.en: The wonderful stories in this novel have been told and retold in teahouses, on theatrical stages, over radio and television, on movie screens, and in countless households.
sentences.structure: 现在完成时被动语态 have been told and retold，后接五个并列介词短语表示不同场所，注意介词搭配各不相同（in/on/over）

sentences.structure: 主语 An increasing number of... 表递增，谓语 find 接宾语+宾补（形容词并列）构成 find + O + OC 复合宾语结构
keys: 越来越多的 an increasing number of
外国读者 foreign readers
生动感人 vivid and moving
趣味盎然 full of fun

keys.en: it is no exaggeration to say that

pitfalls: 「数百年来一直」须用现在完成时 has been...for hundreds of years，不可用一般过去时
「反复讲述」被动语态 have been told and retold 易遗漏被动或时态错误
「茶馆、舞台、广播电视、屏幕、家庭」五个并列场所的介词搭配不同（in/on/over），容易一律误用 in
「越来越多的」应译为 an increasing number of 或 more and more，注意主谓一致用复数动词
「生动感人、趣味盎然」为宾补结构 find...vivid, moving, and full of fun，易误译为 that 从句或漏掉并列成分

upgrades.note: immensely 比 very 更正式、语气更强，体现「深受喜爱」的程度
told and retold 是英文惯用搭配，更简洁地道地表达「反复讲述」
短语更正式完整，适合书面语和段落过渡，增强衔接感

upgrades.better: an increasing number of foreign readers
upgrades.note: an increasing number of 更书面、更正式，适合六级写译的文体要求
exceed 搭配 boundaries 更精准，far 加强程度，表达「远远超出」更到位
